trial_definition: Distinct nonoverlapping UTC days; each starts flat, fixed 0.01 BTC quotes; end marked at mids without liquidation
hypothesis: H0: expected 24h marked PnL <= 0; H1: expected 24h marked PnL > 0
interpretation: In-sample simulated PnL after configured execution fees, not proof of live or out-of-sample profitability. Daily resets differ from continuously held monthly positions.
limitations: Only one month already used for strategy development; observations may not be independent or stationary.
Configured maker/taker fees applied to executed fills; borrowing costs, market impact, depth, margin and liquidation omitted. Unlimited capital and spot borrowing assumed.
Funding signal uses causal minute-close premium proxies, not exact historical funding forecasts.
Daily terminal PnL includes unrealized marks and omits liquidation spreads; USD PnL is not a return on fixed capital.
Resampling reuses observed days and creates no new market history. HAC and bootstrap are small-sample diagnostics.

methods.primary: One-sided one-sample t-test of daily marked PnL against zero, alpha 0.05; 95% two-sided t interval
methods.robustness: Bartlett/Newey-West HAC at 3 and 7 daily lags (asymptotic normal reference); centered circular block bootstrap at block lengths 3 and 7, 20,000 resamples
methods.decomposition: Price-only statistics describe the same trade path after execution fees with funding cash removed; not a separate optimized strategy.

summary.strategy: passive perp basis entry, immediate equal-BTC spot hedge
summary.exit_execution: Funding payers only in linear premium region during final pre-settlement window
summary.funding_assumption: Recorded settlement cash flows on held positions
summary.funding_signal: Causal weighted average of completed 1m premium-index CLOSE proxies; not exact exchange forecast
summary.limitations: Open positions marked at mids; closed pairs use both executable exit sides and all four leg fees. Spot price-only input uses last-trade proxy with assumed spread. Borrow availability, interest, impact, depth, margin and liquidation are not modeled. No queue reconstruction. Midpoint convergence does not guarantee a positive executable round trip.
